Name: Ahitub, Son of Amariah
Summary: Son of Amariah and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:7; 1 Chronicles 6:52: Son of Amariah and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ahitub stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
